paite: Jakeh tapa Agur thute. Huai mi in Ithiel kiang ah, Ithiel leh Ukal kiang ah.
heading: Agur Thute
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

paite: Chihtaktak in kuamah sang in ka haizaw a, mihing theihsiamna ka nei kei.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

paite: Pilna ka sin nai kei a, Mi Siangthou theihna leng aka nei kei, achi hi.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

paite: Van ah kua akahtouta in ahong kumsuk a? Akhuttum sung ah kua'n huih alakhawmta a? Apuansilh in kua'n tuite atun a? Lei tawpnate kua'n ahihkipta a? Amin bang ahia? Huan atapa min bang ahia, na theihleh?
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

paite: Pathian thu chiteng ettel ahi; amah a muangte a ding in lum ahi.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

paite: Athute ah behlap ke'n, hon sal dia, zuauthei amuh in na om kha ding hi.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

paite: Thil nih ka hon ngen; ka sih ma in huaite hon kitheihmohbawl ke'n.
heading: Thupil Dangte
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

paite: Bangmah lou leh zuau kei a kipan gamlapi ah suan in. Gentheihna hiam hauhsaknate hiam hon pe ke'n; kei a dia kiphamoh an in hon vak in.
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw ka kham in, nang ka hon kitheihmohbawl in, TOUPA kua ahia? Ka chi kha ding hi. Ahihkeileh, ka genthei in, ka gu in, ka Pathian min thanghuaitak in ka bawl kha ding hi.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

paite: Apu kiang ah sikha gense ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang ahon hamsiat dia, mohtansak in na om ding hi.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

paite: Apa uh hamsiat suan khat a-om a, anu uh vualzawl lou.
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

paite: Amau mitte a siangthou suan khat a-om a, ahi a lah anitna ua kipan silsiang louh ahi uhi.
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

paite: Suan khat a-om a, aw amitte uh sanghah hi na e; huan amitkhu vunte sansak in a-om hi.
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

paite: Ahate uh namsau bang leh ahate uh temta bang suan khat a-om uh, lei a kipan a migenthei leh tasamte mite lak a kipan anekbeina ding in.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

paite: Vot in tanu nih anei a, hon pia in, hon pia in, chi in akikou ua. Thil thum lungkimsak theih ngei louh a-om uh, ahi, li, "Hun e,” chi lou.
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

paite: Han leh sul hut; lei tui a hihlungkim a om lou; huan mei, "Hun e," chi lou.
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

paite: Apa nuihsan mit leh anu thuman musit, phaizang va- akte'n atawm ding ua, muvanlai noute'n ane ding uhi.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

paite: Thil thum kei a ding a lamdang lua a-om ua, ahi, ka theih louh li.
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

paite: Huihkhua a muvanlai lampi; suangpi tung a gulpi lampi; tuipi lak a long lampi leh pasal nungak toh alampi.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

paite: Huai mah bang in angkawm hat numei lampi ahi; ane a, zapi in akam aka a, gitlouhna ka hih kei, achi hi.
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

paite: Thil thum ziak in lei aling a, huan thil li apuak zoh louh ziak in;
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

paite: sikha kumpipa hong hih lai leh mihai ankham lai;
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

paite: numei huathuaitak in pasal aneih a, sikha nungak in api aluah in.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

paite: Leitung ah aneu thil li a-om ua himahleh apil mahmah uh.
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

paite: Miksite hat lou ganhing hon ahi ua, himahleh nipi lai in anek ding uh asutuah ua;
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

paite: kawl sazawte hat lou pawltak ahi ua, himahleh suangpi heng ah a-inn abawl uhi.
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

paite: Khaukhupte'n kumpipa anei kei ua, himahleh ahonhon in avek un kilem in apai uh;
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

paite: inhikte na khut a na tawi theih ahi ua; himahleh kumpipate inpite ah ateng uh.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

paite: Apai chiang ua thupi thil thum a-om ua, ahi, apai chiang ua thupi, li.
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

paite: Humpinelkai, gamsa laklak a hat penpen, bangmah ma ah akiheimang kei hi;
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

paite: kidouna sakol; keltal leng; huan kumpipa, amite ma a pai.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

paite: Na kiletsak a haitak a na gamtatleh, ahihkeileh ngaihtuahna gilou na neihleh, na kam tung ah na khut koih in,
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

paite: nawitui pei in nawituidat a- omsak a, nak hek in sisan asuahkhesak; huchi mah bang in thangpaihna paisuak in kilaina a-omsak hi.
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
